inputs.sequence_prompt:
One continuous fifteen-second live-action shot beginning exactly at this image, continuing the airship's gentle ascent already underway. Camera is fixed to the deck, with the same frame and viewing axis throughout. Exactly three people: Locke on LEFT, Celes in CENTER, the ONE Setzer at the existing controls on RIGHT. Their feet stay in the same original locations. Preserve their faces, proportions, costumes and equipment. Same red wooden masts, ropes, rigid rails, brass balusters and original lever. No new viewpoint, people or equipment. No camera orbit, zoom, pan or cut.
Match this corrected source's restrained neutral colors exactly: natural beige and tan human skin, ivory fabric, dark blue trim, red wood, brass metal and muted gray-blue sky. Steady soft neutral light on faces, hands and fabric. No pink or violet color wash, no magenta skin or scene, no colored glow or flashing lights. Do not intensify saturation. The city remains far BELOW the deck in the lower-right background, coherent solid buildings moving very slowly downward as the ship rises. Nothing flies past, floats across or emerges from the background. No loose boards, moving platforms, flying objects, new vessels or new structures.
0-5 seconds: Continue the slow ascent and steady low engine sound from the first instant. A moderate breeze briefly lifts the lower edge of Celes's dress. She naturally gathers a small fold of her OWN skirt at her right thigh with her right fingers to keep it down, looking down briefly. Her feet stay grounded and separated; she does not touch the rail. Locke notices, shifts his weight securely onto both feet without walking, and looks toward her face. Setzer stays at the existing controls, holding the same lever and facing forward.
5-10 seconds: Setzer makes a short careful adjustment of the EXISTING lever with his already gripping right glove, then turns only his head slightly toward the others and says calmly in Brazilian Portuguese: <d>[Portuguese] Agora, rumo ao Império.</d> This is the ONLY speech and only Setzer speaks. Celes lifts her eyes from her skirt to Locke and gives a brief confident nod. Locke responds with a small nod and restrained smile; neither moves from their own location or crosses another body. Setzer keeps both hands at the same original controls.
10-15 seconds: Setzer looks ahead again as the engine settles into a steady hum. The breeze softens. Celes gradually releases the fold of cloth; it falls naturally without changing dress design. She and Locke turn their eyes toward the receding city and then forward, with visible relief. Their hair and clothing continue to move gently. The coherent city slowly recedes downward, the same skyline remains visible low in frame. The deck and camera remain steady together; no roll, turn or acceleration burst. End with ongoing flight and live reactions, no pose freeze or fade.
Keep three separate intact bodies and the same left-center-right arrangement throughout. Exact same controls, mast and railing geometry. No extra hands, new handles, duplication, objects crossing the distant city, dissolving buildings, exposure pumping or flicker. Native audio: continuous soft engine and wind, ONE Portuguese sentence by Setzer; no music, singing, narration or other voices.
